live.description: A Worker runs the Simulation adapter resolved from the exact model registry. Only accepted-boundary values are displayed, and no provisional Experiment or Preset content is created.

live.zeroContent: Startup creates no Workspace, Snapshot, Preset, or Lesson. The default is a composition setting and is never stored as an alias in content.
live.snapshotGateDescription: On explicit Snapshot creation, the model restores the frozen saved-Draft checkpoint, settles it under the canonical periodic policy, accepts P1 only, and captures a fresh exact checkpoint. This is a numerical eligibility gate, not physiological or clinical validation.

modelLimitations.title: Research model limitations
items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.
A 0D lumped-parameter model cannot resolve spatial blood flow, local wall stress, or three-dimensional hemodynamics.
The current exact V3 package is an experimental development default. It does not claim release readiness, simulation readiness, or clinical validation.
Parameters and outputs are approximations and require validation for each intended scientific use.
